name: icon-tile
description:
A square surface that gives icons a consistent footprint.

- **`variant`**: `outline` (bordered, the default), `soft` (tinted surface), `solid` (filled) or `ghost` (only the icon). All four keep the same footprint, so switching variants never moves the layout.
- **`tone`**: `neutral`, `primary`, `brand`, `success`, `warning`, `info` or `destructive`. The default is primary for solid and neutral otherwise.
- **`size`**: from `xs` to `xl`.
- **`radius`**: `default` (clamped to the tile) or `full` (circular).

Renders a `<span>`; wrap it in a `Button` or `Link` to make it interactive.
